description:
Poll a verification request until it reaches a terminal state (completed, expired, or cancelled). Uses exponential backoff (2s initial, 1.5x, 30s max) with jitter.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait time in seconds (default: 50, max: 300). Keep it under your MCP client's request timeout (the SDK default is 60 s) — a longer wait is cut off by the client while the server is still polling. On timeout the tool answers status "pending"; call it again with the same identifier.

name: wait_for_request

action_context.description: The action the person is asked to authorize; null when the request carries none

action_type.description: Type of action for verification request or authorization

callback_url.description: The webhook URL set on the request, if any

computed_state.description: Additive machine-readable effective state: re-derives expiry from expires_at (never trusts the stored status). BOTH `is_expiring_soon` and `next_action` are role-aware — `next_action.role` says which side this envelope was computed for, and the two fields are consistent within it. Present only on authenticated owner/requester and recipient responses; absent on public/third-party surfaces.

last_status.description: On timeout: the last non-terminal status observed, or null when none was

message.description: On timeout: what to do next (call the tool again with the same identifier)

status.description: "pending" when the wait ran out before a terminal state; otherwise the resource's own status

timeout_seconds.description: On timeout: the wait budget this call was given

validity_requirement.description: Required proof freshness as set on the request (e.g. "7d"); null when none was set
